name: carnivore-burst-autopsy
question: How do the short-lived meat-eating groups of the reworked grand world end? The three worlds that grew them in full-package-long (seeds 2812, 2814 and 2815, same settings, so they replay exactly) are re-run with the diet ledger recording, every 500 ticks and by diet band: births, deaths by cause (ran out of energy, killed by a meat eater, killed by anyone else), how fed the dead were and how old, income and costs. An answer: what kills meat eaters (diet above 0.75) as a group fades.
